# `firearms.component` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The seven DataComponentType registrations and their codecs (`FA-3`, `docs/spec/04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-005`, `docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md`).

### `record Ammo(Identifier caliber, int loaded)` — `src/main/java/firearms/component/Ammo.java`
The firearms:ammo component: { caliber, loaded }, present once a weapon has been loaded at least once (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md`, `docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3).

### `class AmmoCodec` — `src/main/java/firearms/component/AmmoCodec.java`
The firearms:ammo component's persistent and network codecs.
- `Codec<Ammo> CODEC`
- `StreamCodec<net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, Ammo> STREAM_CODEC`

### `record Base(int version, Identifier weaponId)` — `src/main/java/firearms/component/Base.java`
The firearms:base component: { version, weapon_id }, present on every item of this mod's own weapon type (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md`).
- `Base of(Identifier weaponId)` — weaponId at the current schema version (`BaseCodec#VERSION`), for a freshly-crafted weapon.
- `boolean readOnly()` — Written by a newer build than this one (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md` DATA-REQ-003): the weapon is treated as bare and unmodifiable rather than reinterpreted, mirroring create_metered_motor's own Stats#readOnly().

### `class BaseCodec` — `src/main/java/firearms/component/BaseCodec.java`
The firearms:base component's codecs (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md`), following create_metered_motor's StatsCodec precedent exactly: version defaults to #VERSION so an unversioned value still reads (`DATA-REQ-001`), and #normalise migrates any version this build can read up to #VERSION on the spot (`DATA-REQ-002`) — a placeholder migration, since 1.0 has never shipped a version below its own.
- `int VERSION` — The schema this build writes (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md` version 1).
- `Codec<Base> CODEC`
- `StreamCodec<net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, Base> STREAM_CODEC`

### `class ComponentRegistration` — `src/main/java/firearms/component/ComponentRegistration.java`
The seven DataComponentType registrations `docs/spec/04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-005 defines, the same BuiltInRegistries.DATA_COMPONENT_TYPE pattern create_metered_motor's own MeteredMotor.STATS uses.
- `DataComponentType<Base> BASE` — firearms:base — always present on a weapon item; which base it is and its schema version.
- `DataComponentType<Ammo> AMMO` — firearms:ammo — present once a weapon has been loaded at least once.
- `DataComponentType<Identifier> ATTACHMENT_MUZZLE` — firearms:attachment_muzzle — the muzzle attachment's own id, absent when the slot is empty.
- `DataComponentType<Identifier> ATTACHMENT_OPTIC` — firearms:attachment_optic — the optic attachment's own id, absent when the slot is empty.
- `DataComponentType<Identifier> ATTACHMENT_MAGAZINE` — firearms:attachment_magazine — the magazine attachment's own id, absent when the slot is empty.
- `DataComponentType<Identifier> ATTACHMENT_GRIP` — firearms:attachment_grip — the grip attachment's own id, absent when the slot is empty.
- `DataComponentType<Identifier> ATTACHMENT_STOCK` — firearms:attachment_stock — the stock attachment's own id, absent when the slot is empty.
- `DataComponentType<Identifier> attachmentComponent(Slot slot)` — The one firearms:attachment_ component type carrying slot's own attachment id — on a weapon item, that slot's present-or-absent state; on this mod's own attachment item for that slot, which of the slot's attachments this stack is (`firearms.item.AttachmentItem`).
- `void register()` — Forces this class's static registrations to run; call once from Firearms#onInitialize().
